(local), byte-identical to the receipt old_main artifacts; the old arm's exact rustc command with the attr-base dylib gives the same bytes. findings: ALL bundle growth comes from R3-D (runtime/shim.js fast paths). R3-D alone: +149..+370 gz on every bundle except uplot (shim unchanged); its program.js gz is unchanged (0 to -26), i.e. the growth is the minimal shim: shim gz +321..+629 per bundle (copy/copy_nonoverlapping/compare_bytes array fast paths, ptr_eq fast path, str_bytes/str_len _mru/_sub_map caches). Not over-inlining.

R3-B (slice/str scalarization, bounds peeling, DCE) shrinks every artifact (compact -174/-178, idiomatic -524/-541, marked -144, minisearch -223, fflate -499, idb -138, idb_lines -199, ky -25, explorer -273, workbox -17).
R3-C (inliner + cell unboxing) shrinks most (idb -1075, idb_lines -973, idiomatic -342/-350, compact -175/-185, fflate -130, minisearch -92) but GROWS ky +77 and workbox +11.

ky (+319 integrated): R3-D +257 (shim +465 raw-shim gz), R3-C +77. R3-C cause: <Result as Try>::branch (core$result$impl_27_branch, 145 B, 3 call sites in two async closures, fetch_loop/fetch_once closures) is now inlined at all sites and deleted; the two closures grow +174 and +135 raw bytes, net +139 raw / +102 program gz. The lane report bytes_min for those items moved only +76/-24/-21 (net -161 incl. the deleted callee), so the inliner cost model judged it profitable while the final program grew. This is an over-inlining size regression (violates R3-C brief "no regression from over-inlining" / "if any change grows ... tighten the threshold"), small in absolute terms. Same branch inlining present in the integrated candidate (branch item absent, 11 vs 10 Err-construction sites).

workbox (+141): R3-D +149; R3-C +11 from a new hoisted Location const (src/workbox.rs:98:21, used-#[track_caller] substitution) +52 raw and one closure +39 raw, offset by -24 elsewhere. Minor; track_caller materialization rather than inlining budget.
workbox_direct (+150): R3-D +160 (compare_bytes/str_bytes fast paths in shim), R3-C -11.

marked (+201): R3-D +355 (shim); program gz -233 in the candidate (R3-B -168, R3-C -54: e.g. workload_run 1803->421 B, __rust_alloc_zeroed and a slice helper deleted, one renderer function +1776 raw from inlining but net program shrinks). Not over-inlining at the bundle level.
compact release-balanced (+49) / release-size (+37): R3-D +370 (shim +619 gz) offset by R3-B -174/-178 and R3-C -175/-185; interaction +37/+39 (the slices' savings overlap).

shrinks: idiomatic -449/-488 = R3-B -524/-541 + R3-C -342/-350 + R3-D +281/+276 + interaction +185/+184 (overlapping savings); fflate -484 = R3-B -499 (slice iter lowering; program gz -452 and shim -115 because fewer helpers are referenced) + R3-C -130 + R3-D +163; idb -929 / idb_lines -870 = R3-C -1075/-973 (cell unboxing + repr: lane reprApplied 0->6, program gz -1026/-820, and fewer shim helpers referenced: shim gz -297/-394) + R3-B -138/-199 + R3-D +237/+254.

Running control with incremental sysroots against candidate pre-existing non-incremental sysroots would have made the comparison asymmetric.
